prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. Interior room seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image: "Hinterzimmer", the back office of the High Voltage nightclub - the crew boss's planning room, cramped but cosy, smoky dim light, scuffed wooden floorboards and a worn rug as the large walkable area in the middle. Keep all important objects inside the central area; the outer strips at the far left and right edges are plain wall or floor.
TOP WALL LEFT: a big cork job board covered in pinned photos, maps and paper slips (no readable text) - the most eye-catching spot, lit by a small hanging lamp.
TOP CENTER: a heavy old wooden desk with a green banker's lamp, a cash ledger, a rotary phone and an old monitor; a worn leather office chair behind it.
TOP WALL RIGHT: a photo wall with many framed old crew photos (faces not visible, just blurry shapes), a dusty bottle shelf.
CENTER RIGHT: a large planning table with a city map spread on it, push pins, coffee mugs, a desk lamp, a few chairs around it, and a rolling whiteboard covered with arrows (no letters).
LEFT SIDE, lower: a sagging brown leather sofa with a small side table and an ashtray.
BOTTOM RIGHT CORNER: a battered wooden crate full of junk, cables and old clothes.
BOTTOM LEFT: the door back into the club, open a crack, pink-violet club light spilling in through it.
Small stuff at the edges: stacked beer crates, a safe, a coat stand, cables drawn thin so they don't hide the floor.
EXITS clearly readable: BOTTOM edge left of center - the door back into the club.
Time: night, warm yellow lamp light with neon pink seeping in from the club.
